title: Ben&Ben, British pop band Take That team up for new song 'Glow'

blocks.text: Filipino folk-pop sensation Ben&Ben collaborated with British pop group Take That on their new song “Glow,” which will be featured on the deluxe edition of the latter’s 10th studio album, “Dreamers,” out on Nov. 20. Ben&Ben and Take That performed the new track during the British band’s show in London Palladium on Friday, Nov. 13 (Saturday, Nov. 14, in the Philippines).
